Supreme Court asks EC to set timeline for TMC symbol dispute

The Supreme Court of India has asked the Election Commission of India (ECI) to fix a timeline for making a final decision on the dispute over the Trinamool Congress (TMC) party name and symbol. The court referenced the delay in resolving the Shiv Sena symbol dispute as a reason for its query. The ECI is expected to set a deadline for the resolution.
